messages:
lara: Quick heads-up — docs PR #3247 (migration guide + SDK snippet) needs to land before feature-flag freeze tomorrow 10:00 PT. I split out the excerpt for the SDK change so it’s docs-only. Can reviewers commit to a merge slot?

samir: I can review today before EOD PT. tagging @olivia for API accuracy.

olivia: will take a look in ~90m. Do we need a separate release note entry?

lara: yes, add one short line under v1.8 -> "SDK: updated init snippet for connection pooling". Keep it simple.

ci-bot: Preview build failed: broken internal link in migration-guide.md -> /guides/old-snapshots (HTTP 404). Full log: https://ci.redwood/example/3247

matt: that broken link is from an earlier rename — easy fix. I'll push a docs-only commit referencing the new path `/guides/snapshots` and rerun.

chris: heads up: deployment team will start the FF freeze at 10:00 PT tomorrow. Anything merged after that needs ops signoff.

samir: ok timeline wise — if matt fixes the link and I approve within 2 hours we can merge before freeze.

olivia: quick question on SDK snippet — the new `client.connect({pool: true})` is backward-compatible with older versions? If not we should gate behind the versioned docs note.

lara: good catch. The snippet works only on SDK v2.1+. Add a short callout: "Requires SDK v2.1+" and a link to the upgrade notes.

matt: pushed fix (link + callout). Preview build queued.

ci-bot: Preview build passed ✅ — public preview URL: https://preview.docs.redwood/3247 (expires in 48h).

chris: can we land to `main` or should this go to `release/v1.8` first? Ops prefers release branch for anything touching FF rollout docs.

lara: ops preference noted — target `release/v1.8`. samir, are you able to approve and request merge into that branch?

samir: Approved. I’ll open the merge into `release/v1.8` and request the canary deploy. @devex-bot please reserve a merge slot before 09:30 PT tomorrow.

devex-bot: Merge slot requested for 2067890123. Slot tentatively reserved for 09:15 PT if CI remains green. React with :thumbsup: to confirm.

olivia: small nit in migration guide paragraph 2, wording on rolling back feature flags — I'll push a one-line fix in the same PR. Don’t expect it to break preview.

lara: thanks. If anything changes after 09:30 PT we’ll hold and escalate to ops. Otherwise proceed. :rocket:
